character: Historic original village of Courchevel at 1,300m. Traditional Savoyard stone chalets, narrow lanes, authentic alpine hamlet feel. Quiet and charming. Good for budget-conscious. Free shuttle to 1850. Church of Saint-Jean-Baptiste (17th C).
dining: La Cabane (ski-in). La Table de Mon Grand-Père. La Cortona Pizza (family Italian, wood-fired). Local ferme-auberges nearby.
shopping: Small convenience store, bakery, ski rental shops. Limited compared to 1850.
apres_scene: Quiet village atmosphere. Le Bar de l'Etaphor for local vibe.
activities_nearby: Praz ice skating. Biathlon centre. Hiking trails. 4-min gondola to 1850. Access to the 600km Trois Vallées.
